method.timing: five serial alternating fresh-cache processes per engine; no profiler or verification flags; same guest assertions and value=1
method.baseline_label: current means prior unified-GC working tree, not the c7e407d5 commit
method.final_label: same sources plus bounded guarded placement and merged external loop entries

struct_view_diagnostic.stage: placement convergence repaired, before external-entry merging; diagnostic counters excluded from all timing samples

exact20k_cpu_profile.method: sample, 2 seconds at 1 ms, main thread; begins 1.3s after launch. Installed-code metadata logged only during artifact installation. Separate profiled run, not a timing sample. Exclusive counts, no double counting.

limitations: macOS ARM64 local only; no Linux LSan or x64 execution claimed
sample window is statistical attribution, not an exact per-category decomposition of all wall time
100000-iteration exploratory profiles are not the 20000-iteration acceptance workload
background OS load uncontrolled; measurements serialized for owned tasks
root/type/layout checks and quotas are preserved; no V8 pointer layout borrowed without a Wasmoon lifetime proof

v8_invocation_only_profile.method: Node inspector Profiler.start after Module/Instance construction, stop after exact 20000-iteration probe; separate from timing runs

source_fingerprint.method: sorted git listed tracked and nonignored untracked existing modules/scripts files; path + NUL + SHA256(file bytes), accumulated SHA256
